## Bundle Details

### P1b — #259-followup: Graph Builders + Verify Modes (Score: 87/100)

**6 new builders added** (`src/graph/builders/`):

| Builder         | Source                                        | Nodes emitted | Edges emitted              |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------- |
| `adr.ts`        | `docs/SYSTEM/DECISIONS.md` frontmatter        | ADR           | `decides` (ADR→INV)        |
| `req.ts`        | FEATURE_MATRIX.md / REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX.md    | REQ           | `demands` (REQ→FILE)       |
| `ast.ts`        | JSDoc `@enforces`/`@invariant` annotations    | SYMBOL        | `implements` (SYMBOL→INV)  |
| `test-nodes.ts` | Test title `[INV-NN]` tags                    | TEST          | `proves` (TEST→INV)        |
| `evidence.ts`   | `.evidence/SUMMARY.json` files                | EVIDENCE      | `produces` (EVIDENCE→GATE) |
| `canon.ts`      | `docs/SYSTEM/CANON.md` `## CANON-NN` headings | CANON         | `promotes` (CANON→INV)     |

**4 new `arbiter verify graph` failure classes:**

- `orphan-node` — non-GATE node with zero edges
- `broken-ref` — edge endpoint not in node set
- `missing-evidence` — INV→GATE path without EVIDENCE prover
- `stale-prover` — TEST node path absent on disk

**`--format dot|mermaid`** wired into `arbiter graph build`. Viafera dogfood: 230 nodes / 84 edges.

Findings:

- P4: `ast.ts` builder uses regex for JSDoc parsing (not full AST). Sufficient for `@enforces(\"INV-NN\")` pattern but fragile for complex multi-line annotations. Tracked for future AST upgrade.
- P5: `utils.ts` `walkFiles()` is synchronous; acceptable for current repo sizes.

---

### P5a — #260 + #261 + #262: Gauntlet + CI Plan + Semantic Diff (Score: 85/100)

**#260 — Gauntlet pairwise generator**

`src/gauntlet/{ipog.ts, spec.ts, emitters/{typescript,java,rust}.ts}` + `src/commands/gauntlet.ts`. IPOG algorithm: deterministic, greedy, constraint-aware. Per-stack emitters: TS→`test.describe.each()`, Java→`@ParameterizedTest`, Rust→`#[rstest]`. Bespoke YAML parser (no js-yaml runtime dep). `arbiter gauntlet verify` checks spec hash + feature flag presence.

**#261 — Governance-aware affected CI**

`src/commands/ci.ts` — `arbiter ci plan` traverses Provenance Graph from changed FILEs through SYMBOL→INV→GATE chains, emits JSON execution plan with impacted invariants, risk class, required gates. `arbiter ci verify-plan` post-run check. Graceful degradation when no graph exists.

**#262 — Semantic diff review**

`src/commands/review-diff.ts` — `arbiter review diff` compares two graph snapshots (built at base + head refs), reports: enforcement delta per INV, removed test provers, implicit ADR supersession, risk-class change. `--json` for machine-readable output. `src/templates/github/workflows/semantic-review.yml.ejs` emits L2/L3 workflow.

Findings:

- P3: `arbiter review diff --post-pr` (post as GitHub PR comment) is wired but requires `GITHUB_TOKEN` in env; no documentation in CLI help. Add to docs.
- P4: Gauntlet graph integration (SYMBOL→GAUNTLET_SPEC edges) is a stub placeholder — the builder side not yet connected. Functional without graph; full integration deferred.
- P4: `ci plan --format mermaid` visualises plan graph but requires `graphviz` on PATH; no error message if absent.

---

### P5b — #264 + #265: Cross-Repo Compare + Agent-Rules Export (Score: 84/100)

**#264 — `arbiter compare`**

`src/compare/{model.ts, load-repo.ts, detectors.ts, report.ts, workspace.ts}` + `src/commands/compare.ts`. Five pure detectors: divergent-enforcement, contradictory-adr, promotion-asymmetry, unique-to-one-repo, risk-class-divergence. Bespoke YAML workspace spec parser. `--fail-on contradiction` gate mode. `--format report.md` writes markdown.

**#265 — `arbiter agent-rules`**

`src/agent-rules/{intermediate.ts, targets.ts, emitters/{claude,cursor,copilot,aider,windsurf}.ts}` + `src/commands/agent-rules.ts`. Target-agnostic intermediate format v1.0. Five emitter targets. `arbiter agent-rules verify` detects drift between generated files and graph. `docs/REFERENCE/AGENT_RULES.md` added.

Findings:

- P4: `compare` detector for "contradictory ADRs" uses string similarity heuristic (no semantic NLP). Catches only structural contradictions (same ADR ID, opposite `status`). Semantic contradiction detection deferred.
- P4: `agent-rules export` for Cursor uses `.cursorrules` format which Cursor deprecated in favour of `.cursor/rules/` directory. Update in follow-up.
- P5: `load-repo.ts` falls back to INV catalog when no graph exists — logged as warning but not surfaced in report header.

---

### P5c — #263: Time-Travel Governance (Score: 86/100)

**`arbiter blame`**: `src/graph/{history.ts, blame.ts}` + `src/compliance/loader.ts` + `src/commands/blame.ts`. Git log harvester parses commit messages for `Notary:` footer sections. Timeline builder reconstructs per-node history. Four renderers: text, json, mermaid (gantt), markdown-audit. Optional `compliance.yaml` maps INV→SOC2/ISO/PCI. `docs/REFERENCE/BLAME.md` added.

`GraphNode` extended with optional `created_at`/`commit_ref` temporal fields (backwards-compatible).

Findings:

- P4: `blame --violations` requires CI log files in `.evidence/` to count violations; on repos without evidence harness this section is empty rather than reporting "no data". UX improvement tracked.
- P5: Performance claim "< 1s on Viafera" not yet verified (Viafera at 15k commits); tested on arbiter (600 commits), < 200ms.
